title: capsicum indicum var. luteum
intro: Capsicum indicum var. luteum, commonly known as Yellow Frigga pepper, is a variety of Capsicum plant, which is a species of flowering plant in the nightshade family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Capsicum indicum var. luteum include reducing inflammation, improving circulation, and providing antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include capsaicinoids, flavonoids, and carotenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer effects.
